title: Swansea Au Vodka reportedly in talks over £500m sale to BuzzBallz owner
summary: Au Vodka is reportedly in talks to be sold to BuzzBallz owner for £500m, marking a significant acquisition in the spirits industry. Co-owner Charlie Morgan previously gained notoriety in 2013 after a high-profile incident with a Chelsea footballer. The deal would consolidate premium vodka brands under one owner.
content: Au Vodka co-owner Charlie Morgan earned infamy in 2013 after being kicked by the Chelsea footballer.

zh.title: 斯旺西Au伏特加据报正在就5亿英镑出售给BuzzBallz所有者进行谈判
zh.summary: Au伏特加据报正在与BuzzBallz所有者进行出售谈判，价格为5亿英镑，这标志着烈酒行业的一次重大收购。共同所有者查理·摩根曾在2013年因与切尔西足球运动员的高调事件而声名狼藉。该交易将把优质伏特加品牌整合在一个所有者旗下。

title: 'Don't get too comfortable': Wall Street’s ‘fear gauge’ hits 2026 low — here's why it's unlikely to last
summary: The VIX, Wall Street's volatility "fear gauge," has hit its lowest level of 2026, signaling growing investor complacency about market risks. However, strategists warn this calm is unlikely to persist as markets historically face turbulence during this period. The low volatility suggests investors may be underestimating tail risks.
content: A falling VIX points to growing investor complacency ahead of a traditionally turbulent time for markets, strategists warn.

zh.title: "别太舒服了"：华尔街的"恐惧指数"触及2026年低点——为什么它不太可能持续
zh.summary: 衡量华尔街波动率的"恐惧指数"VIX已触及2026年最低水平，表明投资者对市场风险的自满心态日益增长。然而，策略师警告，这种平静不太可能持续，因为历史上市场在这一时期往往会面临动荡。低波动性表明投资者可能低估了尾部风险。

title: The AI productivity payoff is coming. Here are 20 stocks primed to capture the gains as adoption spreads.
summary: Goldman Sachs identifies 20 stocks positioned to capitalize on AI productivity gains as the sector moves beyond infrastructure plays. Investors have been overfocused on AI infrastructure companies rather than those that will benefit from widespread AI adoption. This potential shift in investment focus could reshape sector leadership and valuations.
content: So far investors have been focused on artificial-intelligence infrastructure plays rather than productivity beneficiaries, says Goldman Sachs.

zh.title: 人工智能生产率收益即将到来。这是20只准备好在应用扩展时获得收益的股票。
zh.summary: 高盛确定了20只股票，这些股票准备好利用人工智能生产率收益，因为该行业超越了基础设施项目。投资者一直过度关注人工智能基础设施公司，而不是那些将从广泛人工智能采用中受益的公司。这种潜在的投资焦点转变可能会重塑行业领导力和估值。

title: Trump threatens to 'bomb' Oman if it 'gets in the way' as U.S.-Iran ceasefire expires
summary: Trump has threatened military action against Oman if it interferes as the U.S.-Iran ceasefire expires without a new agreement. Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has dropped to record lows amid escalating Middle East tensions. The dispute underscores risks to global trade routes and geopolitical stability.
content: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.

zh.title: 美伊停火期满，特朗普威胁如果阿曼"挡路"将"轰炸"阿曼
zh.summary: 特朗普威胁，如果阿曼干预美伊停火期满后无新协议的局面，将采取军事行动。霍尔木兹海峡航运流量跌至创纪录低位，中东紧张局势不断升级。这一争端凸显了全球贸易路线和地缘政治稳定面临的风险。

title: Veteran strategist Jeff Currie turns bullish on gold. Here’s why
summary: Veteran Goldman Sachs strategist Jeff Currie has turned bullish on gold, noting that despite recent volatility, the pattern shows successively higher highs and higher lows. This technical strength suggests a sustained uptrend in the precious metal. The shift reflects growing confidence in gold as a safe-haven asset amid market uncertainty.
content: Recent volatility is likely to continue but "the spike is higher and the low is higher," Currie told CNBC on Monday.

zh.title: 资深策略师杰夫·柯里转向看好黄金。原因如下
zh.summary: 高盛资深策略师杰夫·柯里转向看好黄金，指出尽管近期波动性较大，但价格走势显示连续创出更高的高点和更高的低点。这种技术面强势表明贵金属将持续上升。这一转变反映了在市场不确定性中对黄金作为避险资产信心的增强。

title: 'I used food banks while my ex owed thousands in child maintenance'
summary: Parents told BBC Panorama they relied on food banks while ex-partners owed thousands in unpaid child maintenance. The government agency responsible for securing child support payments is reportedly driving families to breaking point through administrative failures. The revelations expose systemic failures in enforcing child financial obligations.
content: Parents have told BBC Panorama the agency tasked with helping to secure financial support for children after separation or divorce is driving them to breaking point.

zh.title: "当前任欠数千英镑子女抚养费时，我靠食物银行度日"
zh.summary: 家长向BBC全景栏目表示，他们依赖食物银行，而前伴侣欠了数千英镑的子女抚养费。负责确保子女抚养费支付的政府机构据报导通过行政失误将家庭推向崩溃边缘。这些曝光揭示了在执行子女财务义务方面的系统性失败。

title: Investor dubbed ‘AI stock god’ had 56% of his funds in these two stocks before the July blow-up
summary: An investor known as the "AI stock god" had 56% of fund assets concentrated in just two stocks before July's AI sector correction. The Situational Awareness fund was over 75% invested in five AI stocks, making it essentially one leveraged bet on artificial intelligence. The concentration left the fund severely exposed when the sector corrected.
content: At the end of the first half of 2026, on the cusp of a major correction in the sector, more than three quarters of the Situational Awareness fund was betting on just five stocks, all of which were, in essence, one big bet on AI.

zh.title: 被称为"AI股票之神"的投资者在7月市场崩盘前在这两只股票中投入了56%的基金资产
zh.summary: 被称为"AI股票之神"的投资者在7月AI行业调整前将56%的基金资产集中在仅两只股票中。该Situational Awareness基金在五只AI股票上的投资占比超过75%，本质上是对人工智能的一个杠杆赌注。这种高度集中的投资组合在该行业调整时使基金面临巨大风险。

title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California
summary: Meta faces a critical legal battle in California led by the state's attorney general just weeks after losing a case in New Mexico. The company potentially faces "astronomical" consequences as the proceedings reach a decisive phase. This represents an intensifying legal challenge that could impact Meta's operations and finances.
content: Less than two weeks after a loss in New Mexico, Meta faces a much bigger legal test in a case being co-led by California's attorney general.

zh.title: Meta面临"天文数字"般的后果，加州的法律战斗进入关键时刻
zh.summary: Meta在加州面临由州检察长主导的关键法律诉讼，这是在新墨西哥州败诉数周后发生的。随着诉讼进入决定性阶段，该公司可能面临"天文数字"般的后果。这代表了一项日益加剧的法律挑战，可能对Meta的运营和财务状况产生影响。

title: The SoFi rebound has only just begun, says Piper Sandler
summary: Investment firm Piper Sandler initiated coverage of fintech company SoFi with an overweight rating, signaling the beginning of a significant rebound. The analyst expects substantial upside ahead for the stock. This bullish outlook could reignite investor interest in the fintech sector.
content: The investment firm initiated coverage of fintech company with an overweight rating.

zh.title: 根据Piper Sandler，SoFi的反弹才刚刚开始
zh.summary: 投资公司Piper Sandler以超配评级启动了对金融科技公司SoFi的覆盖，标志着一次重大反弹的开始。分析师预期该股票存在巨大的上升空间。这种乐观的前景可能会重新激发投资者对金融科技领域的兴趣。

title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Alibaba, Intel, Sandisk & more
summary: Alibaba, Intel, Sandisk, and other companies are experiencing the largest premarket price movements, signaling early market focus and potential trading momentum. These moves often precede broader market direction and investor sentiment shifts. Tracking premarket leaders helps identify emerging market trends.
content: These are the stocks posting the largest moves premarket.

zh.title: 盘前波动最大的股票：阿里巴巴、英特尔、闪迪等
zh.summary: 阿里巴巴、英特尔、闪迪等公司正经历最大的盘前价格波动，预示着市场早期关注和潜在交易势头。这些波动通常预示着更广泛的市场方向和投资者情绪变化。追踪盘前领跑者有助于识别新兴市场趋势。

title: Why Goldman Sachs thinks the Fed won’t be hiking interest rates in September
summary: Goldman Sachs expects the Federal Reserve to hold interest rates steady in September, assuming no dramatic economic data changes between now and the decision. The forecast suggests monetary policy will remain stable in the near term. This view reflects expectations of paused rate hikes as inflation moderates.
content: Goldman expects that the Fed will stand pat — barring any dramatic data.

zh.title: 高盛为何认为美联储九月不会加息
zh.summary: 高盛预期美联储在9月份将保持利率稳定，假设现在和决策之间没有重大经济数据变化。该预测表明货币政策在短期内将保持稳定。这一观点反映了随着通胀温和化，加息可能暂停的预期。

title: Alibaba answers Meta’s AI challenge with new laptop-ready model
summary: Alibaba launched a laptop-ready AI model and released weights of its most powerful Qwen model, directly escalating competition with Meta in open-source artificial intelligence. The move broadens access to powerful AI across consumer and enterprise devices. This release could accelerate AI adoption globally and reshape competitive dynamics.
content: Alibaba launched a laptop-ready AI model and released the weights of its most powerful Qwen model, escalating its rivalry with Meta in open-weight AI.

zh.title: 阿里巴巴推出笔记本电脑版AI模型应对Meta挑战
zh.summary: 阿里巴巴推出了笔记本电脑适配的AI模型，并发布了其最强大的通义千问模型的权重，直接升级与Meta在开源人工智能领域的竞争。该举措扩大了在消费者和企业设备上获取强大AI的途径。这一发布可能会加速全球AI采用并重塑竞争格局。

title: Vista Energy up 5% after billionaire Peter Thiel buys stake in the Argentine shale oil producer
summary: Peter Thiel's hedge fund disclosed a $76 million stake in Argentine shale oil producer Vista Energy, driving shares higher in premarket trading. The investment by the billionaire investor signals confidence in the energy sector despite broader economic uncertainties. Vista's stock surge reflects market enthusiasm for Thiel's backing.
content: Peter Thiel’s hedge fund disclosed a $76 million stake in Argentine oil producer Vista Energy, sending its shares higher in premarket trading.

zh.title: Vista Energy在亿万富翁彼得·蒂尔入股阿根廷页岩油生产商后上涨5%
zh.summary: 彼得·蒂尔的对冲基金披露了对阿根廷页岩油生产商Vista Energy的7600万美元股份，推高了盘前交易中的股价。这位亿万富翁投资者的投资表明对能源部门的信心，尽管存在更广泛的经济不确定性。Vista的股票飙升反映了市场对蒂尔支持的热情。

title: What will TV look like in three years? Media insiders share their predictions
summary: CNBC surveyed media insiders to forecast the television market over the next three years, examining subscriber trends and viewership shifts. The outlook reflects ongoing industry disruption as streaming and digital platforms reshape traditional media consumption. Expert predictions provide insight into media sector direction and investment opportunities.
content: CNBC asked media insiders what they think the TV market — from pay TV subscribers to sports ratings — will look like in three years.

zh.title: 三年后电视会是什么样子？媒体业内人士分享他们的预测
zh.summary: CNBC调查了媒体业内人士，以预测未来三年的电视市场，研究了订户趋势和收视率变化。展望反映了流媒体和数字平台正在重塑传统媒体消费的持续行业中断。专家预测提供了对媒体部门方向和投资机会的见解。

title: Virgin takes step towards running Channel Tunnel rail services
summary: Virgin is advancing plans to operate up to 20 daily rail services through the Channel Tunnel to Europe. The company requires additional regulatory approvals for overseas track operations before launching service. The move represents Virgin's expansion into cross-border European rail transport.
content: Firm wants to run up to 20 daily journeys to Europe but it must get additional approval for overseas tracks.

zh.title: 维珍迈出了运营英吉利海峡隧道铁路服务的一步
zh.summary: 维珍正在推进计划，通过英吉利海峡隧道每天运营多达20班列车服务前往欧洲。该公司在启动服务前需要获得额外的监管批准以进行海外轨道运营。这一举措代表了维珍向跨境欧洲铁路运输的扩展。

title: Ferrari Luce: Polarizing EV becomes a $40 million collector’s item
summary: Ferrari's first fully electric car, the Luce, sold at auction for $40 million nearly three months after the automaker's €550,000 unveiling. The record-breaking sale highlights the vehicle's status as a collector's item despite design criticism from some who view it as a departure from Ferrari's traditional styling.
content: The auction of the Luce comes nearly three months after Ferrari unveiled its first fully electric car, which was priced at 550,000 euros (roughly $640,000).

zh.title: 法拉利Luce：争议性电动车成为4000万美元的收藏品
zh.summary: 法拉利首款纯电动车Luce在拍卖会上以4000万美元的价格成交，距该汽车制造商以55万欧元推出该车型已近三个月。这创纪录的销售突显了该车辆作为收藏品的地位，尽管一些人认为它偏离了法拉利传统风格而对设计提出了批评。

title: Japanese automakers vulnerable to one-two punch of Iran war, yen rally
summary: Japanese automakers face compounding economic headwinds from potential regional conflict with Iran and a strengthening yen that could erode export competitiveness. The dual pressures pose significant risks to Japan's automotive industry.
content: Japanese automakers vulnerable to one-two punch of Iran war, yen rally

zh.title: 日本汽车制造商面临伊朗战争和日元升值的双重打击
zh.summary: 日本汽车制造商面临来自伊朗潜在地区冲突和日元升值的复合经济逆风，后者可能会削弱出口竞争力。这些双重压力对日本汽车工业构成重大风险。

title: If Meta loses this trial, Instagram and Facebook could change forever
summary: US states are pursuing legal action against Meta to force substantial overhauls of Instagram and Facebook aimed at better protecting young users. The lawsuit could fundamentally reshape how the platforms operate if successful.
content: US states are suing the social media giant to force an overhaul of its platforms for young users.

zh.title: 如果Meta败诉，Instagram和Facebook可能永远改变
zh.summary: 美国各州正在对Meta提起法律诉讼，以迫使Instagram和Facebook进行大幅改革，以更好地保护年轻用户。如果诉讼成功，这可能会根本性地改变这些平台的运营方式。

title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
summary: Ferrari's first electric vehicle, the Luce, achieved a record $40 million sale price at auction, though the car's contemporary design sparked criticism among commentators accustomed to the brand's dramatic styling. The sale demonstrates strong collector demand despite polarizing reception.
content: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.

zh.title: 法拉利首款电动车以创纪录4000万美元成交
zh.summary: 法拉利首款电动车Luce在拍卖会上以创纪录的4000万美元成交,尽管这款车的当代设计风格引起了习惯于法拉利戏剧性造型的评论家的批评。这次销售显示了收藏家的强劲需求,尽管接受度存在分歧。

title: Stock futures are little changed after S&P 500 posts three-week win streak: Live updates
summary: Stock market futures show minimal movement as the S&P 500 completes a three-week winning streak. The market remains near historic highs.
content: The stock market remains near all-time highs.

zh.title: 标普500指数连赢三周后，股指期货基本持平：实时更新
zh.summary: 随着标普500指数完成连续三周的上涨，股市期货显示微乎其微的波动。市场保持在历史高位附近。

title: U.S. stock futures little changed as investors ponder the Fed’s next move
summary: U.S. stock futures remained flat as traders await signals from the Federal Reserve about future interest rate policy. A quiet trading week has investors focused on the Fed's next monetary move.
content: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday after a quiet week on Wall Street, as investors await hints from the Fed concerning the outlook for interest rates.

zh.title: 投资者思考美联储下一步举措之际，美国股指期货基本持平
zh.summary: 在交易员等待美联储关于未来利率政策信号之际，美国股指期货保持平稳。平静的交易周让投资者关注美联储的下一步货币政策举措。

title: Japan second-quarter GDP grows 1.1% on an annualized basis, missing expectations
summary: Japan's second-quarter GDP grew 1.1% on an annualized basis, falling short of economist forecasts of 2% growth. The slower-than-expected expansion raises questions about the health of the world's third-largest economy.
content: On an annualized basis, Japan saw growth of 1.1%, against estimates of 2%.

zh.title: 日本第二季度GDP按年率增长1.1%，低于预期
zh.summary: 日本第二季度GDP按年率增长1.1%，低于经济学家预测的2%增长率。低于预期的增长引发了对全球第三大经济体健康状况的疑问。
